io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.runtime.spi.ShimFeature

Packages that use ShimFeature
Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend
Code generation: turns optimized Juno IR into a complete Arduino sketch, generated assembly plus the C++ runtime shim it links against, for every supported board.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.runtime
The C++ runtime shim the generated assembly links against: the arena allocator and collector, Serial, threads, and every optional library binding a program's ShimFeatures call for.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.runtime.spi
The contracts between the code generators and the runtime shim: ShimFeature, the optional shim parts generated code asks for, and CoreRuntime, which each Arduino core implements in backend.runtime.core.
